subject: general
question: Six friends, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a circle facing the centre of the circle. A is 2ⁿd to the right of E. Only one person sits between F and D. B and D are immediate neighbours. F is 3rd to the right of B. C is second to the right of D. Who sits between D and F?
solution:
**Given: **

Six friends, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting in a circle facing the centre of the circle.

**Solution: **

(1) A is 2nd to the right of E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8414dd583677b1b7bb14523c4896d34748616f442f74b0237587e82f7d889aef.png] 

(2) F is 3rd to the right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9da0ff6c4a7e52bebd3be82dd3c36aca90e0f1dd4a74363d48fc5f709cf0f2d4.png] 

(3) B and D are immediate neighbours.

 
• it is possible only Case 1 Further it will be divided in two sub cases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b04a86b3b53fc1e4ce9f7a58d3420dd0354538c528eb7412defb1cf654fef54.png] 

(4) C is second to the right of D.

 
• It is possible only in Case 1(b).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f560849e22ba0df7c6f8b71ab18e439b7951a9220601513df373ea082ae0dda0.png] 

Here, **A** sits between D and F.

Hence, **'Option 1**' is the correct answer.
